purpose: Measure whether splitting exact tool identification from selected-only argument construction improves a frozen speech-capable core over one-call joint construction and an equal-contact joint draft-revise control on a fresh paired 104-row discovery roster.

population.strata: 13 samples per tier across all eight Audio2Tool tiers

direct_m0.context: Original speech and complete registry contract only; no OBS or K32 supply.

joint_one_call.context: Original speech, shared canonical OBS, and dense K32 joint routing and parameter ground.

joint_draft_revise.context: Reuse the byte-exact sealed JOINT_ONE_CALL response as the first draft; a fresh second workflow receives canonical draft state, shared OBS, speech, and the same eligible K32 ground.

select_then_fill.context: SELECT sees routing-only K32 values; FILL sees only selected occurrences' detailed parameter values with count and names locked.

execution.generation_contact_formula: 104 direct + 104 OBS + 104 joint draft + 104 SELECT + 104 joint revise + 104 FILL

decision.approximately_1000_sample_expansion: closed unless split has a positive lower 90 percent paired-bootstrap bound against both joint controls, nonnegative tool and slot effects, a positive direct contrast, and no tier with more than one net exact loss
decision.knowledge_backtrack: return to knowledge construction if K32 supply dominates; revise SELECT information if reachable tools are missed; revise selected-only parameter supply or FILL control if selection is correct but exact calls fail
